protocol.replication: GpuReplica actual cyclic copies: physical tensors, own lengths/scales

protocol.end_to_end_timer: direct model.encode_query + query F.normalize + full search/top-k
protocol.timing: original c.measure; perf_counter with device synchronize;3 warmup5repeats
protocol.int8_residency: values int8 + scalesFP32 + lengthsint32 always GPU resident; float decode multiply per1024-video block, no renormalization
